audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (1) The page credits Ravenous Flock with pulling you in — Ravenous Flock is his passive, which collects Soul Fragments that heal him and raise his max health. The pull is Nevermove's recast. (2) Nevermove is described as projectiles that root when you walk into them; the root is actually on the wave's RETURN pass, which is the whole reason players get caught walking back out.
audit.why: Riot's Nevermove text: launches a wave forward, it then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits, and Swain may then pull all rooted champions closer. Riot's Ravenous Flock text: ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase max health — no displacement at all. Nevermove is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 850 range, which is the timer the whole lane runs on. Counter Strike dodges attacks only, so his Q, E and R all land through it — the page already says this correctly.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0], early, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now attribute the pull to Nevermove's recast and state the return-pass root with the real cooldown.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Swain contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 you have only Leap Strike; his Death's Hand cone pokes from 750 range for free, so concede the opener and farm.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Swain's Demonic Ascension is down.
edits.after: Empower into Leap Strike is a real burst, but Nevermove and Q poke keep it a coinflip — step up only on the root.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Swain must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online: leap in, Empower the landing hit, and Counter-Strike-stun him — his drain is not strong enough yet.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Demonic Ascension's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Bait Nevermove out — 12s at rank 1 — then all-in and bank the lead; with no dash at all he cannot kite the extended trade away.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Swain's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R's Armor/MR lets you tank Demonic Ascension (flat 120s) while the third-hit ramp shreds him — leap on his root-down.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Demonic Ascension's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force outpaces his first AP item, and with no dash he cannot escape Leap Strike — force every all-in.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Swain carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You still edge the 1v1, but soul-stacked Demonic Ascension and his AoE lockdown win teamfights — close before that.

edits.before: Land Nevermove (E) to root you, then pull you in with Ravenous Flock and Q-cone you down in the drain fight he wants
edits.after: Root you on Nevermove's return pass, recast to drag you in, and Q-cone you down in the drain fight he wants

edits.before: Swain has no dash and no escape, so the lane is yours the moment you can reach him — but his Nevermove root is the whole early game. It's a slow set of projectiles that lock you in place if you walk a straight line at him, and then his Death's Hand (Q) cone and autos drain you for free while Ravenous Flock pulls you in. Don't facecheck a Leap Strike on a fixed path; angle the leap onto a side minion or wait the root out. At level 1 with only Q you just farm and respect his Q poke. Counter Strike dodges his autos but not his single-target spells, so early its value is the stun on your engage, not damage block.
edits.after: Swain has no dash and no escape, so the lane is yours the moment you can reach him — but his Nevermove root is the whole early game. The wave only roots on its return pass, so the danger is walking a straight line back through it, and he recasts to drag you in for the Death's Hand cone. Don't facecheck a Leap Strike on a fixed path; angle the leap onto a side minion or wait the 12s root out. At level 1 with only Q you just farm and respect his Q poke. Counter Strike dodges his autos but not his single-target spells, so early its value is the stun on your engage, not damage block.

notes: Real factual error killed: the page told the reader Ravenous Flock pulls them in. Ravenous Flock is Swain's passive (Soul Fragments, heal, permanent max health); the pull is the Nevermove recast. Packet reports zero defects and zero suspect names for this matchup, so nothing else was flagged automatically. Content layer says 'Grandmaster at Arms' for Jax's R where the full layer says 'Grandmaster's Might' — champion-wide inconsistency, flagged not fixed.
